name: kata
description: AI-driven QA workflows codified as reusable kata, powered by Claude Code and Codex runtime skills.
author: kata contributors

scripts.lint: biome check engine/src engine/tests .claude/agents .claude/skills plugins tools rules
scripts.lint:debris: bun run scripts/lint/check-debug-files.ts && bun run scripts/lint/check-stale-paths.ts && bun run scripts/lint/check-runtime-artifacts.ts
scripts.ci: bun run lint && bun run lint:debris && bun run lint:agents && bun run lint:paths && bun run lint:ai-core && bun run lint:agents:codex && bun run lint:skills:codex && bun run type-check && bun run test && bun run test:apps && bun run test:plugins && bun run test:tools
scripts.test:ai-core: bun test --cwd engine tests/ai-core/ tests/policy/ tests/plugins/ tests/runners/ tests/config/ tests/telemetry/ tests/source-ref/ tests/cli/ai-core-cli.test.ts
